definitions.explanation: In ecology, when different species avoid competition by occupying different habitats or using resources differently.
In business or society, when competitors or groups coexist by focusing on different niches or roles.

notes:
{棲|す}み{分|わ}け refers to niche separation in ecology or market differentiation.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {棲|す}む (to dwell, inhabit) + ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide, separate).

WRITING:
Also written as {住|す}み{分|わ}け with a more common kanji.

ECOLOGICAL CONCEPT:
Refers to how species avoid direct competition by using different resources, times, or spaces.

BUSINESS APPLICATION:
Describes how competing businesses find ways to coexist by targeting different market segments.
